title: Canonical derived composition for the projective diagonal
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring] with its actual pulled-back coefficients [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients], ordinary unbounded internal-module derived functors [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull], tensor and coefficient unit [sk-def-sfb-derived-tensor-hom]. For a scheme $Y$ put $P=\mathbf P^1_Y$ [def-nagata-projective-space-base-change], $W=P\times_Y P$, second projection $p_2:W\to P$ and diagonal $\Delta:P\to W$, with degree-zero supported coefficient source $S_\Lambda=\Delta_*\Lambda_P$ [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-category]. Define the canonical isomorphism $\operatorname{Id}_{D(P)}\simeq Rp_{2*}R\Delta_*$ as the right-adjoint conjugate of the canonical pullback section isomorphism $\Delta^*p_2^*\simeq\operatorname{Id}$ of [def-sfb-projective-diagonal-pullback]. Define the identification $R\Delta_*\Lambda_P\simeq S_\Lambda[0]$ using the canonical single-degree right-derived comparison of the exact closed direct-image functor. The left-factor projection of [def-sfb-proetale-projection-exchange-maps] is retained through its unique realization heterogeneously equal to the published map.

proof.text: Construct pushSectionIso by taking the right-adjoint conjugate of pullSectionIso for the second projection. The section equation is pullback.diagonal_snd, so no additional choice of a comparison is made.

The projective-line structural map is separated by properness, and smooth of relative dimension one by the existing standard-chart theorem lem-sc-projective-line-smooth-relative-dimension-one. Smoothness gives local finite presentation. Its diagonal is therefore a closed immersion and locally of finite presentation by lemma-nagata-diagonal-finite-presentation; a closed immersion is finite. Apply the existing finite-pushforward exactness theorem of lem-fd-proetale-finite-pushforward-exact to modules over the universe-lifted integer ring.

Postcomposition by the equivalence from abelian groups to modules over the universe-lifted integers induces an equivalence on sheaves: full faithfulness is inherited and the inverse coefficient equivalence supplies essential surjectivity through its counit. This postcomposition commutes definitionally with direct image. Transfer preservation of finite colimits across these sheaf equivalences. Unfold internal-module lowerStar as mapMod of abelian direct image followed by restriction of scalars, as in def-sfb-module-lower-star. The existing proved mapMod and comap finite-colimit instances compute and reflect finite colimits through the underlying-module forgetful functors, using the cokernel construction of lem-sfb-modobj-cokernels and finite biproducts. Their composition proves diagonalPush_preservesFiniteColimits. The existing canonical single-degree right-derived comparison then defines supportedUnitIso.

Unfold ProjectionFamily, ProjectionNormalized and the fixed native tensor bundle. The published traceProjection family supplies a normalized witness by reflexivity. Any normalized family is pointwise equal to it by eq_of_heq; dependent function extensionality gives equality of families. This proves projection_existsUnique and determines projectionMap.
